notes: Keeps the existing Secure Vault unlock flow stable while allowing the temporary 30-minute authorization session to synchronize across open TEE tabs using BroadcastChannel. Quick Reference and other supported apps can now recognize an already-open Vault without forcing another passphrase or manual search. No decrypted Vault data is persisted to localStorage; the synchronized session remains tab-memory/sessionStorage only. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.69 — Cross-Tab Vault Session
